title: Use pull-down buttons for directly related commands or items

statement.en: Use a pull-down button to present commands or items directly related to the button's action.
statement.ja: buttonのactionに直接関連するcommandまたはitemを示すためにpull-down buttonを使う。

conditions: Use the menu to clarify the action's target or customize its behavior without adding more buttons.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pull-down buttons experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPull-down buttonsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

statement.ja: viewのすべてのactionを1つのpull-down buttonに入れない。

conditions: Keep primary actions directly discoverable instead of requiring people to open the menu first.

title: Balance pull-down menu length with ease of use

statement.en: Balance the length of a pull-down menu with ease of use.
statement.ja: pull-down menuの長さと使いやすさのバランスを取る。

conditions: A minimum of three items can make opening the menu feel worthwhile.
For only one or two items, consider buttons for actions or toggles and switches for selections.
Avoid so many items that finding a specific one becomes slow.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pull-down buttons experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
